title: Orphaned live-panel refresh stall causing empty tiles across tenants
creator: Maya Chen
description: Multiple customers (hosted + dedicated + private) reported console live-panels rendering blank tiles or showing stale zeroed metrics after sustained traffic spikes. Initial triage shows a correlation with background reindex/rebalance events plus an edge-case in the live-panel refresh loop where shard ownership flips and the panel's tenant-scoped watermark is reset to a sentinel value, leaving the panel window empty until a full rehydrate runs. This ticket tracks the production bugfix, customer mitigations, and rollout plan for an idempotent live-panel rehydrate with tenant awareness and stronger watermark handling.
comments: 2026-02-24 - Maya Chen: Customer report received via CSE: hosted tenant 'green-finch' and on-prem tenant 'acme-inc' saw >90% of live-panel tiles returning no datapoints for 20+ minutes after a traffic spike. Repro steps requested and initial logs collected.

2026-02-25 - Liam O'Connor: Reproduced locally with synthetic load. Rebalance triggered by autoscaler simulated; observed live-panel refresh loop set watermark to -1 when shard ownership changed mid-refresh. Added log points in live-panel worker to capture watermark transitions.

2026-02-26 - Engineering note: Root cause hypothesis: race between shard reassign -> cache eviction -> refresh job that checks 'hasDataSince(watermark)'. When watermark is sentinel (-1) the UI interprets as empty window. Low-level metric stamping missed for some tenants because of a brief serialization/desync bug in the telemetry writer during rebalance.

2026-03-01 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented patch: make rehydrate job idempotent and tenant-aware; ensure refresh loop treats sentinel as 'unknown' and triggers immediate rehydrate instead of returning empty. PR opened: #1184.

2026-03-04 - Maya Chen: Customer communication drafted. Temporary mitigations suggested: (1) manual rehydrate trigger from tenant page, (2) enable high-frequency sampling window for affected customers while patch rolls out. Docs link added to customer message template.

2026-03-06 - QA: Smoke tests added for rebalance scenario and for the sentinel-watermark flow. Added unit tests for watermark transitions and for the case where a rehydrate runs concurrently with a refresh request.
2026-03-09 - Operations: Staged rollout to 10% of tenants in hosted region us-west-2; monitoring dashboards created to track live-panel-empty-rate and rehydrate-duration.

2026-03-11 - Incident update: After rollout to 30%, observed 85% reduction in empty tiles for affected tenants. One dedicated customer reported recurrence; ops collected additional logs and identified a custom telemetry ingestion path that bypasses the watermark update. Added a compatibility shim to the patch to handle that ingestion path.

2026-03-13 - Liam O'Connor: Patch merged to main and scheduled for wide rollout in console-2026.03. Postmortem skeleton created and assigned to SRE and Observability leads. Next steps: full rollout, customer follow-ups, and backfill job to rehydrate any remaining stale panels.

2026-03-13 - Maya Chen: Follow-up action: schedule a runbook update for on-call with steps: how to trigger tenant rehydrate, how to check shard ownership, and how to escalate to the rehydrate pager if rehydrate jobs fail repeatedly.
2026-03-13 - Customer success note: Notified all impacted customers of the fix and provided temporary mitigation steps. Collecting confirmations before closing the ticket.
